card.name: Capitalized word stems before endings
card.fires_on: Partway through words written in capitals or oddly split, just before a suffix such as -LY or -ED. Also on emphasized capitalized words like THAT, WAS, IS in running text.

modes.label: Capital stem before suffix
modes.description: A capitalized chunk of a word where an ending like -LY or -ED comes next.
modes.example: S<<LOW>>LY depress the plunger rod so that

modes.label: Emphasized short word
modes.description: A capitalized short word such as THAT, WAS or IS used for emphasis in ordinary prose.

card.writes: It promotes word endings such as -LY, -ED, -ING and -ER, so the model continues the word with a suffix.
card.plain: It fires inside words typed in capitals when an ending like -ly or -ed is about to follow.
